title: Custom Rx Shoppe
description: customrxshoppe.com zoominfo.com/c/custom-rx-shoppe-pharmacy/460515026 Custom Rx Shoppe (The Custom Prescription Shoppe, LLC, founded 2003 in Bellingham/Ferndale, Washington) is a family-owned independent pharmacy founded by pharmacist Kevin Faris with partners Jay Solomon and Rick Adelstein. It combines three specialties — retail pharmacy, long-term care pharmacy for nursing homes and assisted-living facilities (blister packaging, MAR records, med reviews) and a compounding lab making custom medications for people and pets, including hormone replacement therapy. The company serves Whatcom, Skagit and Island counties with free delivery, a mobile app and Medicare/Medicaid enrollment help, and books roughly $6.4 million in revenue with a team of under 10. Its owner also runs Happier at Home Bellingham, a senior home-care agency, giving the business an integrated pharmacy-plus-home-care model.
